cases.name: sample-question
cases.promptMarkdown:
Arena this: how often should the inventory service poll the supplier API for stock levels?

Read `docs/inventory.md` and `docs/supplier-api.md` first.

graders.name: rubric-first
graders.graderMarkdown: PASS if, before the first Agent call that starts a candidate, the worker has written out 3 to 6 gradeable criteria for judging an answer to the polling question (criteria it states, not a plan to write them later), and those criteria do not appear in the prompt of any candidate Agent call. FAIL if no criteria are written before the first candidate starts, there are fewer than 3 or more than 6, or the candidate prompts contain them.

graders.name: judge-after
graders.graderMarkdown: PASS if the Agent call that starts the judge (the one asked to score the candidates against the rubric) comes after the results or completion notices of every candidate Agent call, and the candidates and the judge were not started in one message. FAIL if the judge starts in the same message as the candidates or before all candidates finished, or if there is no judge call.
